profile.summary: BELFOR is a property restoration company that repairs buildings after disasters such as fires, floods and storms. Its services include water damage repair, fire damage restoration, mold remediation and reconstruction for homes and businesses. It is headquartered in Birmingham, Michigan, and has offices in many places, including Hayward, California.

sources.title: Belfor USA Group, Inc. - OMNIA Partners

review.notes: BELFOR USA Group, Inc. is shown by OMNIA Partners as a licensed restoration contractor serving public education. The belfor.com about page confirms the services, the Birmingham, MI headquarters and the 800-856-3333 hotline, and BELFOR's Hayward, CA office (the agenda location) is confirmed by search results. The summary is neutral and supported, and a restoration contract fits a Risk Management, Property & Liability purchase.
